chapter: Church, Bel Canto and the return to music
title: Father Woods and Barry Ulanov
summary: Father Woods was her confessor, arranged for her by Barry Ulanov; she began going to church once back in America.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Father Woods was my confessor. Professor Barry Ulanov got a hold of him to give me instructions.
We'll go back further. You came back to the United States from France. Were you going to church then or...
I went to church a couple of times there with
a couple of friends. But I really started going to church when I came back to America.
